seoTitle: Which Avatar Character Are You? Avatar: The Last Airbender Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Avatar: The Last Airbender test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, Zuko, Iroh or Azula — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the fun-loving kid carrying the weight of the world, the planner with a plan for everything, or the one trying hard to become better? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, family and pressure, and find out which Avatar character you are.

characters.name: Aang
characters.title: The Playful Peacemaker
characters.summary: Joyful, gentle and wise beyond your years. You'd rather make a friend than an enemy — even when the world depends on you.
description: Like Aang, you bring joy wherever you go. He's a fun-loving kid who spent a hundred years frozen in an iceberg.
You believe in peace. Aang's refusal to take a life, even his enemy's, is at the heart of who he is.
You carry a lot of responsibility, but you never let it crush your spirit.
characters.flaw: You avoid hard things until you can't anymore.
characters.signature: An airbender's staff, a flying bison and a lemur on his shoulder.
characters.clashReason: they'd always look for the peaceful way when you want action

characters.name: Katara
characters.title: The Fierce Heart
characters.summary: Caring, determined and full of hope. You look after everyone — and heaven help anyone who hurts them.
description: Like Katara, you're the heart of the group. She keeps everyone fed, safe and together.
You're determined. Katara fought her way to becoming a master waterbender when nobody wanted to teach her.
You're warm and hopeful — but when you're angry, you're a force of nature.
characters.flaw: You can be a bit bossy, and you hold grudges.
characters.signature: A water pouch, her mother's necklace and a very motivating speech.
characters.clashReason: they'd never let you forget what you did

characters.name: Sokka
characters.title: The Funny Strategist
characters.summary: Sarcastic, clever and the planner of the group. You don't have powers — you have ideas.
description: Like Sokka, you're the ideas guy. He's the non-bending strategist who comes up with the plans.
You're funny, sarcastic and a big fan of meat. Also sarcasm. Mostly meat.
You're more capable than people think. Sokka trained with a sword master, forged his own sword and became one of the team's most important members.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself because you're 'just a normal guy'.
characters.signature: A boomerang, a map and a plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd plan everything to death, then crack a bad joke about it

characters.name: Toph Beifong
characters.title: The Unstoppable Rebel
characters.summary: Tough, blunt and completely fearless. People underestimate you — for about five seconds.
description: Like Toph, you refuse to be underestimated. She's blind, and she's also the greatest earthbender in the world.
You don't do polite. Toph ran away from her wealthy, overprotective family to live life on her terms.
You're blunt, sarcastic and hilarious — and fiercely loyal to your friends, even if you'd never say so.
characters.flaw: You push people away rather than admit you need them.
characters.signature: Bare feet, a blunt remark and a punch on the arm (that's how she shows affection).
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think of you. Bluntly

characters.name: Zuko
characters.title: The Redemption Arc
characters.summary: Intense, conflicted and growing every day. You've made mistakes — and you're working hard to become better.
description: Like Zuko, you've had a hard road. He's the banished prince, chasing the Avatar to win back his honour.
You're intense and you feel everything strongly — especially anger.
But you change. Zuko's journey from villain to hero is one of the greatest redemption arcs ever written.
characters.flaw: Your temper gets the better of you.
characters.signature: A scar, a topknot and a very dramatic 'honour'.
characters.clashReason: they take everything so seriously — especially themselves

characters.name: Uncle Iroh
characters.title: The Wise Tea-Lover
characters.summary: Wise, warm and endlessly patient. You believe everyone deserves a second chance — and a good cup of tea.
description: Like Iroh, you've learned from life. He was once a great general and now seeks peace and wisdom.
You love the simple things. Iroh's dream is running a tea shop, and he eventually opens one: the Jasmine Dragon.
You never give up on people. Iroh's love for Zuko never wavered.
characters.flaw: You let people make their own mistakes, even when it hurts.
characters.signature: A cup of jasmine tea and a proverb.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to slow down and have some tea

characters.name: Azula
characters.title: The Perfectionist Prodigy
characters.summary: Brilliant, driven and never, ever satisfied. You're a natural at everything — and you expect nothing less.
description: Like Azula, you're a prodigy. She's a firebending genius who can do what others spend a lifetime learning — including making blue fire.
You're a perfectionist. Anything less than flawless is failure.
Under the control is a lot of pressure — and it can crack you if you're not careful.
characters.flaw: You need total control, and you can't trust anyone.
characters.signature: Blue flames and a smirk that says she's already won.
characters.clashReason: they'd see you as a rival and never let you win

questions.text: Your friends are having a big argument. You...

options.text: Crack a joke. Then a worse one
Take charge and sort it out
Tell everyone exactly what you think. Bluntly
Wait until everyone's calm, then share a bit of wisdom

questions.text: You've got a hard project with a tight deadline. You...

options.text: Make a detailed plan. With diagrams
Put it off — then somehow pull it off at the last minute
Work until it's flawless. Nothing less is acceptable
Push yourself so hard you burn out

questions.text: You've got a whole free day. You...

options.text: Explore somewhere you've never been
Tea, a board game and good company
Train. You're not wasting a day
Find someone to challenge — and win
Prove them wrong. Fast
Let them. It'll make winning sweeter
Train until you're better than all of them
Smile. It doesn't bother you

questions.text: A friend is really upset. You...

options.text: Look after them — food, blankets, the lot
Tease them until they finally laugh
Make them tea and just listen
Try to help. Awkwardly, but sincerely

questions.text: Someone whose opinion matters to you is never impressed, whatever you do. You...

options.text: Keep trying to earn it
Stop caring and find people who appreciate you
Work harder and harder to be perfect
Pour everything into looking after everyone else

questions.text: Someone who hurt you badly asks for forgiveness. You...

options.text: Forgive them. Everyone deserves a second chance
Make them earn it. Slowly
Crack a joke — then quietly forgive them
Refuse. They don't get a second chance

questions.text: You finally have time for a new hobby. You go for...

options.text: Building gadgets — the weirder the better
Anything outdoors where you can move fast
Learning to brew the perfect cup of tea
A combat sport. You love beating people bigger than you

questions.text: The people running your town are wrong about something important. You...

options.text: Break the rules to fix it yourself
Come up with a clever scheme
Explain, patiently and respectfully, why they're wrong
Challenge them head-on. Even if you lose

questions.text: You're the only one who can stop a terrible person — but it means going against everything you believe in. You...

options.text: Find a third way. There's always another way
Face them — then walk away, because you're better than them
Do it, without a second thought
Ask the wisest person you know what to do

questions.text: Your own family's side is doing something terrible. Switching sides means being called a traitor. You...

options.text: Switch. It's right, even if they never forgive you
Stay loyal. Family is family
Do what's right, and make peace with it. You've done harder things
Leave. You never cared what they thought anyway

questions.text: Everyone expects you to save the world, and you don't feel ready. You...

options.text: Run away. Then come back
Train harder than anyone — and drag your friends along
Make a plan so good it doesn't need you to be ready
Act like you're fine. You're always fine
